name: Floodplain Vegetation, Wetland Ecology & Inundation Response
design_rules: vegetation response follows inundation duration and soil wetness
reeds and sedges expand into persistently wet floodplain cells
dry grasses and brush decline under sustained inundation
vegetation can recover after water recedes according to species recovery rate
wetland habitat emerges from hydrology rather than appearing as a static biome decal
North Woodland retains wetland state longer than Ring Basin
habitat changes alter carrying capacity but do not spawn animals directly
floodplain ecology never uses emissive or glow feedback
